title: Otter eating a snack
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- water/ground setting hint -->
  <rect x='10' y='78' width='80' height='14' rx='7' fill='#3a6ea5'/>
  <rect x='10' y='78' width='80' height='5' rx='2' fill='#5b9bd5'/>

  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='24' ry='20' fill='#8b5e3c'/>

  <circle cx='34' cy='20' r='3.5' fill='#c48f5f'/>

  <line x1='56' y1='39' x2='66' y2='38' stroke='#e8c9a0' stroke-width='1'/>
  <line x1='56' y1='41' x2='66' y2='42' stroke='#e8c9a0' stroke-width='1'/>

  <path d='M46 44 Q50 48 54 44' stroke='#3a2414' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <polygon points='56,55 62,51 62,59' fill='none' stroke='#ffb87a' stroke-width='1'/>
  <circle cx='46' cy='54' r='1.2' fill='#2a1a0e'/>

  <path d='M74 70 Q86 66 84 76 Q82 84 70 80' fill='#7a5233' stroke='#a0714a' stroke-width='1.5'/>

  <ellipse cx='62' cy='82' rx='7' ry='4' fill='#7a5233'/>
